answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A velvet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the tide of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the saffron of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, released only after three unrelated confirmations, rewards vest against future work.
